question_en: List the resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.133 (decisions affecting a spec).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum ORDER BY mNum DESC, r.resolutionId LIMIT 15
reference_query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem)
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt, a.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber, r.sequence AS sequence
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, agendaNumber ASC, sequence ASC, resolutionId ASC
